When considering the project’s time constrains and deadlines, the learning curve 
stands out as a critical aspect during the selection process. The developer’s 
familiarity with AWS, offers a significant advantage for rapid development, and 
for navigating their way around the clouds nuanced features. 
Azure offers strong integration with enterprise applications and is heavily 
integrated with the Microsoft ecosystem. However, the proposed project does 
not need a large ecosystem for simple CI/CD pipelines and would be most 
effective with a rapid to deploy solution. Putting all of the services in this regard 
on a similar footing. 
Considering the projects requirements, and the aspects delineated for an affect 
solution; AWS appears to be the most suitable platform. With its competitive 
pricing for compute, high flexibility, and reduced learning curve. While Azure 
offers benefits with the Microsoft ecosystem and database storage prices, these 
were not significant enough to outweigh the tremendous benefits of AWS.
